title: Đề Luyện Thi HSK Atlas (60 câu chuẩn)

questions.text:
jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ liù diǎn qǐchuáng

A. Yes, it is about the morning
B. No, it is about the evening
C. No, it is about yesterday
D. No, it is about next week
questions.listening_script: 今天早上我六点起床 means 'This morning I got up at six.' 早上 = morning.
questions.explanation: 今天早上我六点起床 means 'This morning I got up at six.' 早上 = morning.

questions.text:
tā zài fángjiān lǐ xiě zuòyè

A. Reading a book
B. Doing homework
C. Watching TV
D. Cooking dinner
questions.listening_script: 她在房间里写作业 means 'She is doing homework in the room.'
questions.explanation: 她在房间里写作业 means 'She is doing homework in the room.'

questions.text:
tā qí zìxíngchē qù xuéxiào

A. By bus
B. By car
C. By bicycle
D. On foot
questions.listening_script: 骑自行车 means 'ride a bicycle.'
questions.explanation: 骑自行车 means 'ride a bicycle.'

questions.text:
wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng xīn xié

A. A new hat
B. A new pair of shoes
C. A new shirt
D. A new bag
questions.listening_script: 一双新鞋 means 'a new pair of shoes.'
questions.explanation: 一双新鞋 means 'a new pair of shoes.'

questions.text:
huìyì zài èr lóu de jiàoshì

A. On the first floor
B. On the second floor
C. On the third floor
D. Outside
questions.listening_script: 二楼 means 'second floor.' 教室 means 'classroom.'
questions.explanation: 二楼 means 'second floor.' 教室 means 'classroom.'

questions.text:
diànyǐng qī diǎn bàn kāishǐ

A. At 7:00
B. At 7:30
C. At 8:00
D. At 8:30
questions.listening_script: 七点半 means 'half past seven / 7:30.'
questions.explanation: 七点半 means 'half past seven / 7:30.'

questions.text:
wàimiàn xià yǔ le, bié wàng le dài sǎn

A. Sunny
B. Windy
C. Raining
D. Snowing
questions.listening_script: 下雨了 means 'it's raining.' 带伞 means 'bring an umbrella.'
questions.explanation: 下雨了 means 'it's raining.' 带伞 means 'bring an umbrella.'

questions.text:
zhè jiàn chènshān wǔshí kuài qián

A. 15 yuan
B. 50 yuan
C. 55 yuan
D. 100 yuan
questions.listening_script: 五十块钱 means '50 yuan.'
questions.explanation: 五十块钱 means '50 yuan.'

questions.text:
wǒ gēge shì gōngsī de jīnglǐ

A. A teacher
B. A doctor
C. A manager
D. A driver
questions.listening_script: 经理 means 'manager.' 公司 means 'company.'
questions.explanation: 经理 means 'manager.' 公司 means 'company.'

questions.text:
cóng Běijīng dào Shànghǎi zuò huǒchē yào wǔ gè xiǎoshí

A. Three hours
B. Four hours
C. Five hours
D. Six hours
questions.listening_script: 五个小时 means 'five hours.'
questions.explanation: 五个小时 means 'five hours.'

questions.text:
nǚ: wǒ yǒudiǎnr bù shūfu. nán: nǐ qù yīyuàn kànkan ba

A. Stay home
B. Go to the hospital
C. Take medicine
D. Call a friend
questions.listening_script: The man says 你去医院看看吧 (You should go to the hospital). 医院 = hospital.
questions.explanation: The man says 你去医院看看吧 (You should go to the hospital). 医院 = hospital.

questions.text:
nán: zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn? nǚ: wǒ xiǎng qù páshān

A. Weekend plans
B. Homework
C. A new job
D. A birthday party
questions.listening_script: They discuss 周末打算 (weekend plans). 爬山 = go hiking.
questions.explanation: They discuss 周末打算 (weekend plans). 爬山 = go hiking.

questions.text:
nǚ: fúwùyuán, wǒ xiǎng zuò kào chuānghu de wèizhì. nán: hǎo de, qǐng gēn wǒ lái

A. Near the door
B. Near the window
C. In the middle
D. Outside
questions.listening_script: 靠窗户 means 'near the window.'
questions.explanation: 靠窗户 means 'near the window.'

questions.text:
nǚ: nǐ zěnme chídào le? nán: lùshang dǔchē le

A. He missed the bus
B. There was a traffic jam
C. He overslept
D. He was sick
questions.listening_script: 堵车 means 'traffic jam.'
questions.explanation: 堵车 means 'traffic jam.'

questions.text:
nán: wǎnshang yìqǐ chīfàn ba? nǚ: bù xíng, wǒ wǎnshang yào fùxí gōngkè

A. Eat dinner with the man
B. Review her lessons
C. Watch a movie
D. Go shopping
questions.listening_script: She says 我要复习功课 (I need to review my lessons).
questions.explanation: She says 我要复习功课 (I need to review my lessons).

questions.text:
nǚ: zhège cài hǎochī ma? nán: tài hǎochī le! wǒ hái xiǎng zài chī yí cì

A. Too spicy
B. Very delicious
C. Too expensive
D. Not fresh
questions.listening_script: 太好吃了 means 'extremely delicious.'
questions.explanation: 太好吃了 means 'extremely delicious.'

questions.text:
nán: nín yào jǐ zhāng piào? nǚ: liǎng zhāng, wǒ hé wǒ nǚ'ér

A. One
B. Two
C. Three
D. Four
questions.listening_script: 两张 means 'two tickets.'
questions.explanation: 两张 means 'two tickets.'

questions.text:
nǚ: Wáng lǎoshī, wǒ jīntiān de zuòyè wàng dài le. nán: méi guānxi, míngtiān dài lái ba

A. Friends
B. Teacher and student
C. Doctor and patient
D. Boss and employee
questions.listening_script: She calls him 王老师 (Teacher Wang) and talks about 作业 (homework).
questions.explanation: She calls him 王老师 (Teacher Wang) and talks about 作业 (homework).

questions.text:
nán: tiānqì yuè lái yuè lěng le. nǚ: shì a, dōngtiān kuài dào le

A. Spring
B. Summer
C. Autumn
D. Winter is coming
questions.listening_script: 冬天快到了 means 'winter is almost here.'
questions.explanation: 冬天快到了 means 'winter is almost here.'

questions.text:
nǚ: nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ zhège xiāngzi bān dào sān lóu ma? nán: méi wèntí

A. Buy a box
B. Carry a box to the 3rd floor
C. Open a box
D. Fix a box
questions.listening_script: 把箱子搬到三楼 means 'carry the box to the third floor.'
questions.explanation: 把箱子搬到三楼 means 'carry the box to the third floor.'

questions.text:
nǚ: xiānsheng, nín yào diǎn shénme? nán: gěi wǒ yì bēi kāfēi hé yí gè dàngāo

A. At a library
B. At a café
C. At a hospital
D. At a bank
questions.listening_script: The woman asks what he'd like to order; he orders coffee and cake — they are at a café.
questions.explanation: The woman asks what he'd like to order; he orders coffee and cake — they are at a café.

questions.text:
nǚ: xiānsheng, nín yào diǎn shénme? nán: gěi wǒ yì bēi kāfēi hé yí gè dàngāo

A. Tea and bread
B. Coffee and cake
C. Juice and cookies
D. Water and fruit
questions.listening_script: He says 一杯咖啡和一个蛋糕 (a cup of coffee and a cake).
questions.explanation: He says 一杯咖啡和一个蛋糕 (a cup of coffee and a cake).

questions.text:
nǚ: nǐ shénme shíhou dào Běijīng? nán: wǒ xià xīngqīsān dào. nǐ lái jīchǎng jiē wǒ ma?

A. This Monday
B. Next Wednesday
C. Next Friday
D. This weekend
questions.listening_script: 下星期三 means 'next Wednesday.'
questions.explanation: 下星期三 means 'next Wednesday.'

questions.text:
nǚ: nǐ shénme shíhou dào Běijīng? nán: wǒ xià xīngqīsān dào. nǐ lái jīchǎng jiē wǒ ma?

A. Book a hotel
B. Pick him up at the airport
C. Buy a ticket
D. Cook dinner
questions.listening_script: 你来机场接我吗 means 'Can you pick me up at the airport?'
questions.explanation: 你来机场接我吗 means 'Can you pick me up at the airport?'

questions.text:
nán: nǐ zěnme le? nǚ: wǒ tóuténg, kěnéng shì zuótiān shuì de tài wǎn le

A. She has a stomachache
B. She has a headache
C. She has a cold
D. She broke her leg
questions.listening_script: 头疼 means 'headache.' 睡得太晚 means 'slept too late.'
questions.explanation: 头疼 means 'headache.' 睡得太晚 means 'slept too late.'

questions.text:
nán: nǐ zěnme le? nǚ: wǒ tóuténg, kěnéng shì zuótiān shuì de tài wǎn le

A. Ate too much
B. Slept too late
C. Drank too much coffee
D. Worked too hard
questions.listening_script: She says 昨天睡得太晚了 (slept too late yesterday).
questions.explanation: She says 昨天睡得太晚了 (slept too late yesterday).

questions.text:
nǚ: zhège zhōumò wǒmen qù hǎibiān ba? nán: hǎo a, wǒ hái méi qù guo ne. wǒmen zěnme qù?

A. Go to the mountains
B. Go to the seaside
C. Go to a museum
D. Go shopping
questions.listening_script: 海边 means 'seaside/beach.'
questions.explanation: 海边 means 'seaside/beach.'

questions.text:
nǚ: zhège zhōumò wǒmen qù hǎibiān ba? nán: hǎo a, wǒ hái méi qù guo ne. wǒmen zěnme qù?

A. Yes, many times
B. No, never
C. Yes, once
D. He doesn't say
questions.listening_script: 我还没去过呢 means 'I haven't been there yet.'
questions.explanation: 我还没去过呢 means 'I haven't been there yet.'

questions.text:
nán: nǐ zuótiān qù nǎr le? wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ le hǎo jǐ gè diànhuà. nǚ: wǒ qù péngyou jiā le, shǒujī wàng zài jiā lǐ le

A. Went shopping
B. Went to a friend's house
C. Went to work
D. Went to the hospital
questions.listening_script: She says 我去朋友家了 (I went to a friend's house).
questions.explanation: She says 我去朋友家了 (I went to a friend's house).

questions.text:
nán: nǐ zuótiān qù nǎr le? wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ le hǎo jǐ gè diànhuà. nǚ: wǒ qù péngyou jiā le, shǒujī wàng zài jiā lǐ le

A. Her phone was broken
B. She left her phone at home
C. She was sleeping
D. She didn't hear it
questions.listening_script: 手机忘在家里了 means 'I left my phone at home.'
questions.explanation: 手机忘在家里了 means 'I left my phone at home.'

questions.text:
wǒ zài yì jiā yínháng gōngzuò. měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn shàngbān, xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn xiàbān

A. At a school
B. At a bank
C. At a hospital
D. At a shop
questions.listening_script: 银行 means 'bank.'
questions.explanation: 银行 means 'bank.'

questions.text:
wǒ zài yì jiā yínháng gōngzuò. měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn shàngbān, xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn xiàbān

A. At 3 pm
B. At 4 pm
C. At 5 pm
D. At 6 pm
questions.listening_script: 下午五点下班 means 'finish work at 5 pm.'
questions.explanation: 下午五点下班 means 'finish work at 5 pm.'

questions.text:
xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ tōngcháng qù gōngyuán pǎobù, ránhòu huí jiā zuòfàn

A. Watches TV
B. Goes running in the park
C. Meets friends
D. Takes a nap
questions.listening_script: 去公园跑步 means 'go running in the park.'
questions.explanation: 去公园跑步 means 'go running in the park.'

questions.text:
suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè fèn gōngzuò

A. Bored
B. Stressed and wants to quit
C. Busy but enjoys it
D. Tired and unhappy
questions.listening_script: 虽然…但是… means 'although… but…' — busy but likes the job.
questions.explanation: 虽然…但是… means 'although… but…' — busy but likes the job.

questions.text:
zhōumò de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuan hé péngyou yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú huòzhě kàn diànyǐng

A. Stay home alone
B. Play basketball or watch movies
C. Go to the library
D. Visit family
questions.listening_script: 打篮球或者看电影 means 'play basketball or watch movies.'
questions.explanation: 打篮球或者看电影 means 'play basketball or watch movies.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 36

A. 早
B. 迟到
C. 快
D. 等
questions.explanation: 迟到 (chídào) means 'to be late.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 37

A. 便宜
B. 贵
C. 新
D. 旧
questions.explanation: 贵 (guì) means 'expensive.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 38

A. 帮
B. 走
C. 跑
D. 坐
questions.explanation: 帮 (bāng) means 'to help.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 39

A. 所以
B. 因为
C. 但是
D. 如果
questions.explanation: 因为 (yīnwèi) means 'because.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 40

A. 已经
B. 一起
C. 非常
D. 可能
questions.explanation: 一起 (yìqǐ) means 'together.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 41

A. 年龄
B. 个子
C. 名字
D. 家
questions.explanation: 个子 (gèzi) means 'height/stature.' 他个子很高 = He is very tall.

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 42

A. 已经
B. 正在
C. 还没
D. 从来
questions.explanation: 已经 (yǐjīng) means 'already.' The context says wants to watch again, so already seen it.

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 43

A. 起
B. 不起
C. 得到
D. 不了
questions.explanation: 买不起 (mǎi bu qǐ) means 'can't afford to buy.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 44

A. 因为
B. 如果
C. 虽然
D. 但是
questions.explanation: 如果 (rúguǒ) means 'if.' If you go to Beijing, you must see the Great Wall.

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 45

A. 的
B. 得
C. 地
D. 了
questions.explanation: 得 (de) is used after a verb to introduce a complement: 唱得非常好听.

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 46

A. I found my keys
B. I can't find my keys
C. I lost my bag
D. I need new keys
questions.explanation: 找不到 means 'can't find.' 钥匙 means 'keys.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 47

A. He is older than me
B. He is taller than me
C. He is heavier than me
D. He is faster than me
questions.explanation: 比…高 means 'taller than…'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 48

A. Please leave
B. Please say it again
C. Please sit down
D. Please wait
questions.explanation: 再说一遍 means 'say it once more / repeat.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 49

A. I like Chinese less and less
B. I like Chinese more and more
C. I don't like Chinese
D. I used to like Chinese
questions.explanation: 越来越 means 'more and more.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 50

A. He eats before watching TV
B. He watches TV after eating
C. He eats and watches TV at the same time
D. He doesn't eat while watching TV
questions.explanation: 一边…一边… means 'doing two things at the same time.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 51

A. Friday
B. Saturday
C. Sunday
D. Monday
questions.explanation: 昨天是星期六 — yesterday was Saturday.

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 52

A. The food was bad
B. Too many people
C. Too expensive
D. It was closed
questions.explanation: 人太多了 means 'too many people.' They waited 30 minutes.

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 53

A. Terrible
B. Just okay
C. Very good
D. Too spicy
questions.explanation: 菜很好吃 means 'the food was delicious.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 54

A. Ten
B. Eleven
C. Twelve
D. Thirteen
questions.explanation: 十二岁 means 'twelve years old.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 55

A. Before school
B. During class
C. After school
D. Only on weekends
questions.explanation: 放学以后 means 'after school.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 56

A. At noon
B. After dinner
C. When it gets dark
D. At 5 pm
questions.explanation: 天黑才回家 means 'doesn't come home until dark.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 57

A. By train
B. By plane
C. By car
D. By bus
questions.explanation: 坐飞机 means 'take a plane.' The train is too slow.

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 58

A. Two days
B. Three days
C. Four days
D. One week
questions.explanation: 待三天 means 'stay three days.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 59

A. Too expensive
B. Too slow
C. No tickets
D. Too crowded
questions.explanation: 坐火车太慢了 means 'the train is too slow.'

questions.text:
Câu hỏi số 60

A. For vacation
B. For a business trip
C. To visit family
D. To study
questions.explanation: 出差 means 'business trip.'
